title: A DualDrop-Gated Transformer model for predicting bone metastasis in Asian patients with non-small cell lung cancer: a real-world study with external validation.
summary: A DualDrop-Gated Transformer model combined retinal/clinical predictors for bone-metastasis risk in NSCLC and was externally validated.
ai_technology: The DGT model was developed from clinical and chest-CT-related variables and compared with logistic regression, XGBoost, LightGBM, TabTransformer and FTTransformer.
organization: Shanghai University of Medicine & Health Sciences

evidence.tested: Internal and external cohorts, ROC/calibration/decision curves and ablation comparisons support a bounded retrospective diagnostic result.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: The DGT model was developed from clinical and chest-CT-related variables and compared with logistic regression, XGBoost, LightGBM, TabTransformer and FTTransformer.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
